name: Scheduler for Symfony Messenger
description: Schedule messages to be dispatched cron-like on Symfony Messenger.
project_description:
Integrates the Symfony Scheduler component with Drupal.

 This project is used in combination with Symfony Messenger + Drupal project

 Extensive documentation can be found in the README .

 You can think of the Scheduler component as a cron replacement on steroids. * 

 Provides a clean and modern alternative to cron ( hook_cron ).

 This project is not related to content scheduling, such as Scheduler and Scheduled Transitions.
